events.decision: we decided to use the gRPC streaming variant for the recall pipeline

events.text: because the unary call had p95 latency over 500ms under load and the streaming variant lets us interleave retrieval with reranking

events.decision: chose to fall back to BM25-only when the embedder times out

events.text: since the embedder dependency is the dominant tail-latency contributor and BM25 still delivers usable recall on short queries

events.decision: settled on the additive lifecycle event extension rather than a parallel structure

events.text: because ADR 0008 freezes the existing schema and additive variants do not require a traceSchemaVersion bump while preserving consumer compatibility
